intro: Our facilities in Staplestown are available to club teams, community groups and external clubs. Online booking and payment are coming soon — for now, send a booking request and we'll confirm availability.

facilities.name: AstroTurf Pitch
facilities.description: Floodlit all-weather pitch, ideal for training and small-sided games year round.
facilities.note: Club teams book through their team coach.

facilities.name: Main Pitch
facilities.description: Full-size grass pitch with spectator area — our championship home ground.
facilities.note: Subject to fixtures and pitch condition.

facilities.name: Back Pitch
facilities.description: Full-size grass pitch, perfect for challenge games and league fixtures.

facilities.name: Training Pitch
facilities.description: Smaller grass pitch for drills, juvenile sessions and warm-ups.

facilities.name: The Hall
facilities.description: Indoor hall for bowls, fitness classes, meetings, and indoor training on wet nights.

facilities.name: Events & Entertainment
facilities.description: Saints Bar and Restaurant and function spaces are available for parties, fundraisers and community events.
facilities.note: Talk to us about catering and entertainment options.
